implementation.summary: Host-only repair implements command normalization, launcher wait, recoverable ownership, progress, target identity check, canonical containerd import ID sync and rollback. No product server binary changes.

verification.summary: Baseline actual PowerShell agent reproduces ignored dash-sentinel command. Fixed real-agent execution passes 12 synthetic Docker/HTTP/process cases on macOS PowerShell 7; includes physical marker restoration and quoted paths with spaces. Directory/port/image bootstrap regressions remain passing. Native Windows PowerShell 5.1, Docker Desktop and process-tree end-to-end NOT_RUN on this Mac; Windows CI coverage added but not run remotely. Server update API regression, repository quick gate, 20 CI contract checks and documentation link checks also pass.

documentation.summary: Documented switching, rollback, directory scope, old-agent replacement and native acceptance limits in Chinese and English.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed scoped diff and synthetic adapters; test containers removed, no real credentials/data copied. Combined repair archive contains only the three Windows launcher scripts, instructions and checksums.

release.summary: No push, merge, new Release or 9999 deployment requested for this repair. Local Windows launcher repair candidate only.

rollback: Stop the Windows runtime and restore backed-up start.ps1, scripts/watch-port.ps1 and scripts/update-agent.ps1. Preserve .env and .aide-data. A running legacy agent requires Windows restart before replacing ownership mechanism.
handoff: Native Windows end-to-end activation/rollback remains outstanding; GitHub issue stays open. Local candidate will include previous RC11 directory repairs.
